generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE polished character concept sheet for Dark Nights, a 2D side-view cooperative cave exploration game. Landscape canvas, aim 1536x1024. Input image 1 is environment/style/scale reference, input image 2 is original hero identity reference. Design a new version of this SAME friendly round-hooded explorer that belongs visually in the painted cave. Preserve the round blue-green hood, warm simple visible oval face, two small dark eyes and expressive eyebrows; redesign proportions and clothing, do not just trace the old image. Approximately 2.5 heads tall, substantial torso and clearly separable short limbs, solid readable boots. Dusty desaturated teal canvas hood and work suit, faded ochre shoulder yoke and chest panel, warm cream face, dark brown gloves and boot soles, one compact brown utility belt and a small non-mechanical canvas pouch on the back. No helmet light, no jetpack, no tubes, no weapons, no cape, no new glowing equipment. Charming, slightly wary, capable explorer, not infant-like. Style must match input 1: imperfect confident dark ink outline, broad planar paint shadows, a little dry-brush wear on cloth, subdued storybook gouache. Simplify detail for tiny in-game readability; maximum three broad shading levels, no photorealism or glossy 3D, no fine stitching everywhere. Main visual identity: large warm face framed by dusty teal and one ochre shoulder/chest shape, compact dark feet. Layout: top approximately 65% is warm light stone-grey paper with three clear consistent full-body views, large front three-quarter facing right at left, pure side view facing right center, back view at right. All are the same character with consistent costume and proportions, feet fully visible and aligned. Modest header text 'DARK NIGHTS' and smaller 'CAVE EXPLORER / 01'. Small labels 'FRONT', 'SIDE', 'BACK' only. A small row of five palette chips near the top is okay. Bottom approximately 35% is a wide uninterrupted cave-context panel using the SAME cave aesthetic as input 1: huge olive grey rocks with irregular inked joints, a warm ochre walkable shelf, layered cold teal cavern depth. Show the new character ONCE in this cave, SMALL (about 65 pixels tall on requested 1024px sheet), standing firmly on the ledge slightly left of center, facing right. Preserve the sense of a small vulnerable person in a huge cave. Do not make this a giant character portrait in the cave. This context panel is a conceptual repaint, not a Unity screenshot. Sharp art direction, no UI, no watermark, no extra text or annotations.

generations.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE 2D GAME CHARACTER MODEL SHEET with actual transparent background, landscape 1536x1024, for a simple cutout character that will be redrawn as separate parts and animated in Spine. This is design option A: SIMPLE HOODED EXPLORER. Reference image 1 supplies the muted teal / ochre cave palette only; reference image 2 supplies the original friendly cyan hood and simple face identity. Crucial art direction: flat hand-drawn 2D sprite graphics, solid filled color areas, clean dark slightly irregular contour, ONE simple shadow shape at most per body part. NO painted texture, NO grain, NO volumetric lighting, NO gradients, NO 3D rendering, NO perspective torso, NO complex fabric folds. Build a very easy-to-rig approximately 3-heads-tall human character: medium round soft teal hood, simple open cream oval face, dot eyes and tiny short mouth; narrow plain muted teal one-piece suit, small flat ochre chest rectangle without belt, separate upper arms and forearms, small mitten hands, clearly separate thighs and lower legs, simple dark ankle boots. Straight practical silhouette with enough torso and limb length to bend visibly. Rounded sleeves end at elbow seam, plain knee seams, joint boundaries readable but NO exposed skeleton, NO circles drawn on joints. No bag, straps, buckles, pouches, armor, ear hardware, headlamp, tail, scarf, cape, jetpack, weapons or held objects. Leave broad solid-colored joint-overlap areas for a later cutout artist, but do not draw disassembled pieces. Sheet contains EXACTLY TWO large full body views of THE SAME character and no other figures. LEFT two-thirds: exact symmetrical front orthographic T-POSE, arms extended perfectly horizontally at shoulder height, elbows straight, palms downward as simple mittens, legs straight and separated slightly, both feet on common baseline. RIGHT third: exact orthographic side view facing RIGHT, head and torso in pure profile, visible arm held 25 degrees forward from vertical so wrist does not overlap waist, legs offset slightly so their shapes are visible. Both figures same total height and matching anatomy and clothing. Maintain ample transparent gutters between figures, no overlap, no clipping. Design should look like a charming actual 2D platform game character sprite with clear individual parts, NOT a costume render or detailed illustration. Muted blue-green silhouette, pale warm face, small ochre chest region and very dark boots. Transparent canvas, no floor, no shadow cast on ground, no backdrop, no grid, no checkerboard drawn, no text, no labels, no icons.

Create a production-minded 2D CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET for a side-scrolling hand-inked cave game, design B: THE SOFT-CAP MINER. This is a NEW human protagonist design, not a spacesuit. Attached cave image is ONLY a palette reference, do not paint the environment. Landscape 1536x1024. Plain warm light grey solid background. Two large full-body orthographic drawings of precisely the same character: left 60 percent FRONT T-POSE, right 40 percent SIDE SETUP POSE facing right. T-pose arms perfectly straight horizontal at shoulder level, legs spaced slightly apart; side arm hangs 25 degrees forward of torso leaving the hand separate from hip, show offset legs. Both views same height and feet on same baseline. Flat 2D cutout animation art for Spine: simple overlapping geometric body parts, crisp slightly handmade charcoal contours, SOLID FLAT COLOR ONLY, NO gradients, NO lighting bloom, NO texture, NO hatching, NO painterly mottling, NO three-dimensional depth. Charming small adult adventurer, about 3 heads tall, oval expressive face, dot eyes, small eyebrows and a simple short mouth. A close-fitting dusty blue-green rolled wool cap, one small dark hair tuft below cap, visible human ears, warm cream skin. Faded ochre long-sleeved plain work shirt, dusty blue-green high-waisted work trousers, dark umber simple mittens and short boots. No separate scarf, no belt, no buckles, no pockets, no straps, no bag, no armor, no helmet, no headlamp, no neck ring, no jetpack, no held tools. Keep shirt hem to waist, no hanging fabric over thighs. Head neither enormous nor tiny, legs approximately 40 percent of total height, arms long enough for readable mining and carrying animation. Torso, pelvis, upper arms, forearms, hands, thighs, shins and boots must have distinct easy-to-redraw silhouettes. Elbow and knee seams subtle, use rounded overlapping ends instead of mechanical joints or outline circles. Clothing flat large warm/cool color blocks, very limited palette, ONE dark flat shadow on back-facing limb allowed. Front and side must be consistent in cap profile, facial proportions, costume and limb lengths. The result must look like actual simple 2D game sprites drawn by a character artist, not a 3D model turnaround. Generous margins, complete hands and feet, no cropping, no repeated variants, no disassembled pieces, no background objects, no shadows beneath feet. Small tasteful labels only: 'B / SOFT-CAP MINER' at top, 'FRONT / T-POSE' under left, 'SIDE / SETUP' under right.

Edit this 2D character model sheet into a clean flat-color Spine design reference. Preserve exactly the two-view arrangement, front T-pose at left and right-facing side setup pose at right, same total height and baseline, complete visible hands and feet. Replace ALL black/glowing background with a completely plain opaque warm light grey (#e3dfd5) canvas. Remove ALL glow, bloom, halo and gradients everywhere including on the character. Flat filled colors only. Change cyan to muted dusty teal (#638d8d), chest panel to faded ochre (#bd9444), face to warm light cream (#edc58e), gloves/boots to dark slate (#344649). Use simple slightly irregular charcoal outlines. Specific simplifications: remove the ear hardware protrusion, replace segmented metallic collar with one plain dark fabric neck band; replace the huge dome with a smaller soft round hood, reduce HEAD WIDTH and HEAD HEIGHT by approximately 20 percent, give that saved vertical space to torso so overall figure height stays unchanged. Keep original minimal dot eyes but replace large angular V smile with a small short subtle curved mouth. Smooth flat textile appearance, no space helmet shine, no mechanical joints, no additional accessories. Keep upper/lower arm and leg divisions visible as simple overlap boundaries for cutout rigging. Design is a compact friendly flat 2D canvas-suited cave explorer, about 3 heads tall, not a robot or 3D toy. Add modest heading 'A / HOODED EXPLORER' at top and small labels 'FRONT / T-POSE' and 'SIDE / SETUP' below respective feet. No floor shadow, no grid, no environment. The plain opaque background is intentional; this is a DESIGN BOARD, not exported animation parts.
